AVIATION — TERMLY EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Remove all guards

2. When learning Flight Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Flight Safety.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Safety.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Safety.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Safety.

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. International Cricket Team

4. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.

5. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

6. When learning Career Opportunities in Aviation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Career Opportunities in Aviation.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Career Opportunities in Aviation.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Career Opportunities in Aviation.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Career Opportunities in Aviation.

7. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Keyboard
   C. Monitor
   D. CPU

8. When learning Aviation Security, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aviation Security.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aviation Security.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aviation Security.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Aviation Security.

9. When learning Aircraft Basic Maintenance, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Basic Maintenance.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Basic Maintenance.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Basic Maintenance.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Basic Maintenance.

10. When learning Aircraft Systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Systems.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Systems.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Systems.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Systems.

11. When learning Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.

12. When learning Aircraft Stability, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Stability.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Stability.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Stability.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Stability.

13. When learning Introduction to Simulated Flying, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Simulated Flying.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Simulated Flying.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Simulated Flying.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Simulated Flying.

14. When learning Aviation Entrepreneurship, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aviation Entrepreneurship.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aviation Entrepreneurship.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aviation Entrepreneurship.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aviation Entrepreneurship.

15. When learning Cargo Handling, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cargo Handling.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Cargo Handling.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Career Opportunities in Aviation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Basic Maintenance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
